tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand paper: the warm off-white the light appearance is built on. Ink text and the mark's ink stroke sit on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink: the blue-green night of the map scene and the share card. Paper text reads on it.

tokens.name: chart
tokens.usage: The marker. Chartreuse fills the primary action (Plan a loop, New route) and the frontier while a loop is searched. Text on it is chart-ink. Never a text colour on paper (about 1.8:1).

tokens.name: chart-dim
tokens.usage: Hover state of a chart fill.

tokens.name: chart-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on chart and chart-dim.

tokens.name: marker-dot
tokens.usage: The dot at the end of the mark's folded path, and the snap ring on the map. Hex of the marker as the SVG mark draws it.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground of the account, settings and admin screens (shadcn layer).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text on background, card and popover.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and dialog surface.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and tooltips.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The marker in the shadcn layer: default Button and Badge fill. Text on it is primary-foreground. The link Button variant paints text in primary, which misses 4.5:1 on paper; prefer foreground with an underline.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: skeletons, hovered outline buttons, code chips. bg-muted paints it through --muted-fill, resolved on the root, because the settings, sign-in and planner scenes reuse --muted for their quiet text.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text (descriptions, help, placeholders) on background, card and muted.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill of ghost buttons and menu items; a faint marker tint.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete account, remove a passkey: the destructive Button fill and invalid field borders. White text on it.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Error text on background, card and popover: the destructive Alert, the message under a field, a refused action, the destructive menu item. At least 5.4:1 on paper and muted, 5.8:1 on ink. Not for text on a destructive fill, which is white.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Service notices that need attention but are not errors. Always beside a word or the TriangleAlert icon. As text on paper it is 3.5:1: use it for icons and borders, not body copy.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: A service that is down (status dots in admin). Pair with the word Down.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border and divider in the shadcn layer.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text field border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable control.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1: the marker. Admin traffic charts.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2: slate. Admin traffic charts.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3: deep slate. Admin traffic charts.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4: wood green. Admin traffic charts.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5: sand. Admin traffic charts.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Settings and admin sidebar ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active item marker in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and current sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar divider.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Planner and library ground: the header bar and the page behind the map.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Planner text on bg, panel and field. Also the planner focus outline.

tokens.name: planner-muted
tokens.usage: Planner secondary text: nav links, row keys, specs, map hints. Written --muted in planner.css; renamed here because the shadcn layer owns muted.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Planner hairlines: header rule, row dividers, segmented-control frame, card border.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The floating readout panel, popovers, map controls and route cards.

tokens.name: panel-b
tokens.usage: Border of panel surfaces.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons, stepper buttons and library fields; hover border of cards and chips.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text field fill, route thumbnail ground, pressed chip and sport-mark tile.

tokens.name: field-b
tokens.usage: Text field border at rest.

tokens.name: seg-on
tokens.usage: The selected option in a segmented control.

tokens.name: seg-on-fg
tokens.usage: Text on seg-on.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of ghost, outline, nav and map-control buttons.

tokens.name: icon-box
tokens.usage: The 36px tile behind the sport icon in the panel head.

tokens.name: avatar-bg
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill (inverts against the header).

tokens.name: avatar-fg
tokens.usage: Initials on avatar-bg.

tokens.name: m-base
tokens.usage: Map land.

tokens.name: m-f1
tokens.usage: Map field patch, cool.

tokens.name: m-f2
tokens.usage: Map field patch, warm.

tokens.name: m-wood
tokens.usage: Map woods and parks.

tokens.name: m-res
tokens.usage: Map residential area.

tokens.name: m-bld
tokens.usage: Map buildings.

tokens.name: m-water
tokens.usage: Map rivers and lakes (3px round stroke).

tokens.name: m-minor
tokens.usage: Minor roads: 3px on paper, 1.4px on ink.

tokens.name: m-major
tokens.usage: Major roads: 5px on paper, 2.6px on ink.

tokens.name: m-minor-case
tokens.usage: Minor road casing, 4.4px. None on ink.

tokens.name: m-major-case
tokens.usage: Major road casing, 7px. None on ink.

tokens.name: m-label
tokens.usage: Place names on the map (map-label style).

tokens.name: m-explored
tokens.usage: Roads checked while a loop is searched, dotted.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: The chosen loop: 5px round stroke. Ink on paper, paper on ink; the marker never draws the route.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: 13px glow under the route line.

tokens.name: loser
tokens.usage: Loops that were not picked: 2.6px, at 25% (paper) or 45% (ink) opacity.

tokens.name: pin
tokens.usage: Start pin fill.

tokens.name: pin-halo
tokens.usage: Start pin outline.

tokens.name: marker-fg
tokens.usage: Numbers on route markers (12px, 600).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Name the distance. Get a loop worth taking.
styles.usage: Site hero and share card headline. Scales from 40px on phones (clamp 40px, 4.1vw, 60px).

styles.name: display-narration
styles.sample: The one closest to your distance wins.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big distance in the planner result. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: route-title
styles.usage: Route name in the panel head.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: Wordmark beside the mark in the header.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Your route goes onto your watch or bike computer, and it shows you the way by itself.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop a pin, pick your sport and a distance.
styles.usage: Planner body, row values, field text. The planner sets tabular-nums on everything.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Outline buttons, header nav, row values.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section labels in the panel, in planner-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Route card specs, legends, map hints.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Place names drawn on the map, in m-label.

styles.name: rail
styles.usage: Uppercase step rail and file-card meta. The only uppercase text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segmented-control padding and gap.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Chip gap, stepper gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, button row gap, header end cluster.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Panel body top padding, brand mark gap, map-control stack gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel head gap, card body padding, title-row gap.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Gap between panel body sections; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Library grid gap; toast horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding (cards that pad 20px take radius-card); map controls inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header side padding; panel inset from the map edge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Map attribution tag; small chips (radius minus 4px).

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: The option inside a segmented control (sits 4px inside a radius-lg frame).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Stepper buttons, sport-mark tile, badges (radius minus 2px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The control radius (--radius): buttons, fields, map controls, toasts, icon boxes.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Route cards in the library and planner popovers.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The floating readout panel and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards that pad 20px, so the corner stays concentric (settings and sign-in scenes).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and legend swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces over the map: panel, popovers, map controls, toasts. The only shadow; everything else is flat.

tokens.name: shadow-filecard
tokens.usage: The course-file card on the site's ink scenes.
